newsitem.title: UK: Shipper buying seen on UK meals and feeds market.
newsitem.headline: Shipper buying seen on UK meals and feeds market.

text.p: UK meals and feeds brokers reported mainly shipper buying of high protein soybean on an otherwise quiet market on Thursday.
"We have not done the business our selves but there are reports of shippers buying high protein soymeal at just over 200 stg a tonne," said one broker.

"We are getting reports of some active trade in the nearby months from the continent and that seem's to have got the shippers going here, but no one will come out say what has been done and at what price," said other broker.
High protein soymeal prices in the UK were up three to four stg a tonne while rape meal was 2.50 stg down to 2.50 stg up.
